name: Council of AI — GSPC Measurement Agent
description: Neutral AI-governance measurement body. Measures models and agent systems on 14 GSPC axes under deterministic, frozen conditions; gates for groundedness; signs results (Ed25519) and time-anchors (open timestamps) so any third party can recompute and verify without trusting us. Issued artifact is a measurement credential, never a certification or a compliance claim.

schemes.description: Read + verify are free and anonymous

skills.name: Measure a model or agent
skills.description: Runs a subject through the GSPC measurement axes and returns a signed, time-anchored measurement credential (NOT a certificate). Metadata: model or agent reference, axes requested.
examples: Measure the governance behaviour of model X
Run a signed GSPC assessment of this agent

skills.name: Verify a signed card
skills.description: Recomputes content_id and checks the Ed25519 signature + time-anchor on a card issued by the Council. Free, anonymous, no trust required.

pricing: free to verify; metered to issue (x402)

_register.note: Issues signed measurement credentials. Does not certify, accredit, or claim compliance. Neutrality: measures all labs on one ruler, sells remediation to none.
